Ver, comentar, organizar, proteger, conv: View, comment, organise, protect, convert and sign PDFs in a single freely distributed application, with its source code available on GitHub. This tour shows you the essentials in one minute.
Abre varios PDF a la vez (Ctrl+O o arras: Open several PDFs at once (Ctrl+O or by dragging them onto the window) and switch between them with Ctrl+Tab. Side panel with thumbnails, bookmarks, comments and signatures (F4), search with Ctrl+F and zoom to fit width or page.
Texto que se escribe directamente donde: Text typed directly where it will appear, sticky notes, highlight, underline or strike through (on the text or freehand), rectangles, emojis and eraser. Everything can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
Cambia el texto y las imágenes que ya es: Change the text and images already in the document: the paragraph reflows within its box, and images can be moved, replaced or deleted (C key).
Los campos se resaltan en azul; se escri: Fields are highlighted in blue; you type directly in the field, tick boxes with a click, and calculations and validations work as in Acrobat.
Arrastra miniaturas para reordenar y gir: Drag thumbnails to reorder pages, and rotate, duplicate, delete, insert or extract pages. Combine several PDFs, split one into parts or create a PDF from images, also from the File Explorer context menu.
Firma con los certificados de Windows o: Sign with Windows certificates or a .pfx file, with time stamping and certification. Signatures in the document are verified automatically against the Windows certificate store and the Spanish trusted list.
Desde la barra de Firma, la plumilla: di: From the Signature bar, use the pen nib: draw your signature with the mouse, with a fountain pen stroke in the colour and width you want, or load an image of your scanned signature.
Convierte los escaneos y las fotos en PD: Turns scans and photos into PDFs with text that can be searched and copied. Straightens the page and corrects its orientation before reading it.
Contraseña AES-256 y permisos, marca de: AES-256 password and permissions, watermark, header and footer, Bates numbering, compression and export to Word, images or text.
